newsitem.title: CHINA: China says becomes major world corn producer.
newsitem.headline: China says becomes major world corn producer.

text.p: China has become a major world corn producer, with production exceeding 100 million tonnes in 1996, or one-fith of the world's total, the Xinhua Daily Telegraph said on Monday
China produced 111.986 million tonnes of corn in 1995 and officials have said output for 1996 would be higher.
Area under corn covers about 20 million hectares, or 15 percent of China's arable land, the newspaper said.
About 27 percent of the area is in northeastern Jilin, Heilongjiang and Liaoning provinces and northern Hebei province, it said.

About 40 percent is on plains between the Yellow and Huaihe rivers in eastern Shandong and Jiangsu provinces and central Henan province, and one quarter is in southwestern Yunnan, Guizhou and Sichuan provinces.
Per hectare output was now estimated at about 7,500 kg, Xinhua Daily Telegraph said.
